title: The finite-coefficient Verdier dual over a field has constructible cohomology
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring whose additive exponent is invertible in $k$. Use the ordinary derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme with structure morphism $a:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, compactifiable by [thm-nagata-compactification]. Let $a^\times$ be the right adjoint of $Ra_!$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], put $\omega_T=a^\times\Lambda$ and $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,\omega_T)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then $\omega_T$ is bounded with constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and for every bounded complex $K$ with constructible cohomology sheaves, $D_TK$ lies in $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ and all its cohomology sheaves are constructible.

source.place: 4.1 and 4.2.4 (D_X of a constructible complex is constructible over a field)

proof.text: Both assertions are local on $T$. For an open immersion $u:U\to T$, $u^*\omega_T\cong\omega_U$ [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality] and $u^*R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(K,\omega_T)\cong R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(u^*K,u^*\omega_T)$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. A sheaf on $T$ is constructible if its restrictions to the members of a finite open cover are: intersect the strata on $U_j$ with $U_j\setminus\bigcup_{l<j}U_l$. So assume $T$ affine.

source.place: 4.1: the finiteness of the operations is local on the scheme

proof.text: Choose a closed immersion $i:T\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf A^n_k$ and let $p:P\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the projection, $h:P\setminus T\hookrightarrow P$ the open complement. The composition isomorphism of compact supports [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and uniqueness of adjoints give $a^\times\cong i^\times p^\times$, and [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction] gives $p^\times\Lambda\cong\Lambda_P(n)[2n]$, a lisse sheaf in one degree [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. For $M\in D^b_c(P,\Lambda)$ the closed-support triangle $i_*i^\times M\to M\to Rh_*h^*M\to$ [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle, lem-exc-closed-ambient] has $Rh_*h^*M$ bounded constructible by [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility]; the cohomology sequence and [thm-constructible-serre] make $i_*i^\times M$ bounded constructible, and $i^*i_*\cong1$ [lem-kun-04ca] gives $i^\times M\in D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$. With $M=\Lambda_P(n)[2n]$ this proves the assertion on $\omega_T$. No finiteness theorem beyond finite-type direct images over the field $k$ is used.

proof.text: $D_TK$ is bounded below, since $K$ is bounded above and $\omega_T$ is bounded below. For constructibility, the truncation triangles of $K$ [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles], the long exact sequences of $\mathcal Ext$ sheaves and [thm-constructible-serre] reduce to $K=G$ a constructible sheaf, and then, by a finite partition into strata and the same closure, to $G=c_*u_!L$ with $u:S\hookrightarrow V$ open, $c:V\hookrightarrow T$ closed and $L$ lisse on $S$. Then $R\mathcal Hom(c_*u_!L,\omega_T)\cong c_*Ru_*R\mathcal Hom(L,u^*c^\times\omega_T)$ by the adjunctions $c_*\dashv c^\times$ and $u_!\dashv u^*$ in sheafified form [lem-exc-closed-ambient, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], and $c^\times\omega_T$ is bounded constructible by the argument of Step 2 applied to $c$ and its open complement in $T$.

source.place: 4.1: devissage of a constructible sheaf along strata

proof.text: Etale locally $L$ is the constant sheaf of a finite $\Lambda$-module $L_0$. Resolving $L_0$ by finite free $\Lambda$-modules, $\mathcal Ext^q(L_0,N)$ for $N\in D^+$ with constructible cohomology depends only on finitely many terms of the resolution and of $N$, and each term contributes a finite sum of copies of a cohomology sheaf of $N$; so it is constructible. For $N\in D^+$, $\mathcal H^q(Ru_*N)=\mathcal H^q(Ru_*\tau^{\le q}N)$ because $Ru_*$ maps $D^{>q}$ into $D^{>q}$, and the right side is constructible by [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility]; $c_*$ is exact and preserves constructibility. Hence every cohomology sheaf of $D_TK$ is constructible.
